描述_EN: although it looks like a tiger, it has been given a pair of wings. they usually come in pairs, their posture indicating their position in the tombs. thus this left-facing winged beast would have been placed on the right, and would originally have been accompanied by a right-facing beast positioned on the left. pottery models with a similar function have been found in han dynasty (206bc-ad220) tombs. this figure of a mythical animal, made of hollow, dark-grey unglazed pottery, is thought to be the base for a pole. the sizes of these bases vary, but many are in the form of vigorous animals, such as lions and winged rams.
描述_ZN: 虽然它看起来像一只老虎，但它被赋予了一对翅膀。 它们通常成对出现，它们的姿势表明它们在墓中的位置。 因此，这个朝左的带翅膀的野兽应该是放在右边的，而且最初会有一个朝右的野兽放在左边。 在汉代（206BC-AD220）的墓葬中也发现了具有类似功能的陶器模型。 这个神话中的动物形象是由空心的深灰色无釉陶器制成的，被认为是一个柱子的底座。 这些底座的尺寸各不相同，但许多都是充满活力的动物的形式，如狮子和带翅膀的公羊。
